2. 2. 3. 

Dīghalaṭṭhisuttaṃ. 

94. Sāvatthiyaṃ-

Evaṃ me sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati vephavane kalandakanivāpe. 

Atha kho dīghalaṭṭhi devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ vephavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho dīghalaṭṭhi devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:

Bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto ākaṅkhe ce hadayassānupattiṃ, 

Lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañca sucetaso anissito tadānisaṃsoti.
